name: Joshaviah
title: Descendants of Benjamin
summary: Joshaviah is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Benjamin. He belongs to one of the genealogical lists that were important for establishing family lines after the exile. The name appears only briefly in the biblical records.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Joshaviah is listed among the descendants of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles, as part of the genealogical lists compiled to document the history of Israel's tribes.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: The genealogical record in 1 Chronicles was assembled to preserve family lines, especially after the Babylonian exile, and Joshaviah is part of this historical document.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Significance in Israel's History
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Benjamin played an important role in Israel's history, and the genealogies in the books of Chronicles emphasize the tribe's place in the rebuilt community.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Many of Benjamin's descendants listed in the genealogical records lived in Jerusalem and its surroundings, highlighting the tribe's connection to the holy city.
